name: How long does the framing phase take during an interior remodel?

mainEntity.name: How long does the framing phase take during an interior remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Framing for a typical residential remodel usually takes between two to five days, depending on the square footage and whether load-bearing walls are involved. A straightforward project, like framing a new basement bedroom or closet, can often be completed in one to two days. Larger projects, such as opening a main floor living area or framing a full basement with a bathroom, take longer because they require building soffits around ductwork and plumbing stacks. Abraham Becerra acts as on-site lead to keep framing on schedule before coordinating mechanical sub-trades.
acceptedAnswer.description: Interior remodel framing typically takes 2 to 5 days, depending on the room size, layout complexity, and whether structural beams are being installed.
